Market today: The mood is cautious on tech/AI, with a research firm calling the 'end of the AI trade.' This directly impacts your concentrated tech/chip book, despite some broader market optimism about bipartisanship.

Your holdings: SOXL (-70.33%), MUU (-48.29%), and SPAL (-47.48%) are in dire straits, being leveraged ETFs with massive losses. SMCI (-32.54%) and SMH (-20.76%) also show significant drawdowns in core chip names. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on how the 'end of the AI trade' narrative develops and its impact on your core tech/chip holdings. Also, review the stops on your deeply underwater leveraged positions.

Bottom line: With heavy losses in leveraged tech and a bearish AI outlook, managing risk on your current book is paramount.
plays: Immediately re-evaluate stops on SOXL, MUU, and SPAL. Their current stops are far from current prices and offer no real protection against further losses.
Consider trimming SMCI or SMH if they approach their current stops, especially given the negative sentiment around the 'AI trade'.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The 'end of AI trade' headline makes new tech/chip buys risky without a stronger counter-signal.
